title: Orestack
description: Create regenerating blocks and structures with customizable harvesting and growth stages!
body:
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/QxP3KIy.png)

| [![General](https://i.imgur.com/T6qcmn6.png)](https://github.com/pigaut/Orestack/wiki/General) | [![Configuration](https://i.imgur.com/wVaeeXS.png)](https://github.com/pigaut/Orestack/wiki/Configuration) | [![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/msi1e0L.png)](https://discord.gg/zq6w3Ps8KA) | [![Donate](https://i.imgur.com/fCZ6w1s.png)](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/Giovanni335) |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

**WARNING:** Consider purchasing the [**premium version**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/orestack-regenerating-blocks-%E2%9B%8F%EF%B8%8F-rpg-gathering-system-1-16-5-1-21-4.121905/) to support development, unlock all features, and always stay on the latest version. The free version will be updated 1-2 days after premium.

---

Revolutionize your server's gathering system with Orestack! Customize growth and harvesting stages to create unique gathering mechanics. Use single blocks or entire structures, and effortlessly place them in your world with commands, items, or a wand.

![Showcase](https://i.imgur.com/NqH3QYZ.gif)

---

![Generator Stages](https://i.imgur.com/VlKs3Se.png)

### **Generator Stages:**

- *Depleted*  
- *Growing*  
- *Harvestable*  
- *Replenished*  

---

### **Crop Aging:**

![Crop Aging](https://i.imgur.com/jtDekNx.gif)

---

### **Structures:** *(Max 10 - Premium Only Feature)*

![Structures](https://i.imgur.com/GLP8Z4O.png)  
![Structure Example](https://i.imgur.com/tUTEniT.png)

---

### **Triggers:**

- `onBreak` ~ *when mining a generator block*  
- `onGrowth` ~ *when a generator grows to the next stage*  
- `onClick` ~ *when a generator is clicked*  

---

### **Conditions:**

- *online players*  
- *has permission*  
- *has flag*  
- *has exp*  
- *has exp level*  
- *has item*  
- *has played before*  
- *is flying*  
- *is sneaking*  
- *tool is similar*  
- *tool has enchant*  
- *is placeholder*  
- *has money* ~ *vault and economy required*

---

### **Actions:**

- *broadcast*  
- *lightning*  
- *console command*  
- *drop item*  
- *particle*  
- *sound*  
- *strike block*  
- *drop at block*  
- *particle at block*  
- *sound at block*  
- *drop at player*  
- *particle at player*  
- *sound at player*  
- *give exp*  
- *give flag*  
- *give item*  
- *give money* ~ *requires vault and economy*  
- *take exp*  
- *take flag*  
- *take item*  
- *take money* ~ *requires vault and economy*  
- *set exp*  
- *heal*  
- *damage*  
- *command*  
- *chat message*  
- *message*  
- *strike player*  
- *set flight*  
- *teleport*

### **Block Protections:**

- *Entity Explosion*  
- *Block Explosion*  
- *Leaves Decay*  
- *Block Burn*  
- *Piston Extend*  
- *Piston Retract*

---

### **Supported Plugins:**

- **WorldGuard** ~ Allows players to mine generators inside protected regions  
- **PlaceholderAPI** ~ Allows placeholder use in messages, holograms, and commands  
- **Vault** ~ Allows you to use economy conditions/actions (*has money*, *give money*, and *take money*)

---

### **Planned Features:**

- ~~Holograms~~  
- ~~Make multi-block generators~~  
- ~~Fix placeholders~~  
- ~~Add structure-related commands to create structures fast~~  
- Add a way to rotate generator structure before placing  
- Add hologram messages that spawn and despawn after a set period  

---

### **Notes:**

- Configuration files are subject to change and might need to be rewritten between updates  
- Falling blocks must be supported or they will fall (*The generator will be removed*)  
- Generators will not drop items in creative mode  

---

Support is only given for the latest versions. [Suggestions, support, bug reports.](https://discord.gg/zq6w3Ps8KA)
